title: HelioFITS processing record, format 1.0
description: Per-layer processing record for an export: sources by SHA-256, ordered steps with parameters, and the producer's own scene for a rebuild. It is the detailed companion of the suite provenance format (heliosoftware/spec/provenance.md): an export writes both, and this record never holds a path on the person's computer, a user name or a machine id. Readers ignore keys they do not know; writers only add keys within a major version (suite rule 5). An embedded copy describes the file as it was written; image editors may strip it. Only a sidecar's output.sha256 proves the pixels are the ones described.

hfrecord.description: Format version, MAJOR.MINOR. A minor bump adds optional keys only. A major bump changes meaning; a reader refuses a record whose reader_compat is above its own.

reader_compat.description: The oldest reader version that can read this record correctly. Same rule as Heliad's index reader_compat.

dirty.description: True when the build had uncommitted changes; such a record cannot promise a rebuild.

file_name.description: Base name of the export as written. Sidecars only.

sha256.description: Of the export file. Present in a sidecar, null when the record is embedded in the file it describes.

display_referred.description: True when pixel values are rendered colours, not measured quantities.

scene.description: Scene-wide geometry and timing, shared by every layer. Producer vocabulary kept as written; see the design note for the mapping.

compare.description: Studio's Compare (HS-11) state when on: which layers, divider, palette.

layers.description: Image layers in drawing order: index 0 is drawn first (bottom).

frame_map.description: Movies and series only: which source each layer showed in each output frame. Columnar to stay small.

by_layer.description: layer id -> per output frame, an index into that layer's sources, or null when the layer showed nothing.

native_ref.description: Set instead of native when the same file already carries the producer's scene: 'png:tEXt:hfstudio', 'exr:attr:hfstudio' or 'mp4:comment'. Avoids writing the scene twice.

native.description: The producer's own scene, verbatim and portable (home written as ~). This is what a rebuild loads; the normalized fields above are for people, agents and Heliad.

python_session.description: The .studio session file's JSON plus the render params dict.

summary.description: Generated plain text for people: program, time, one line per layer (dataset, frame count, filter, colour table, caveat), citations. Readers show it first.

provenance.description: The suite provenance object (provenance.md fields: product, version, instrument, observed, credit, rhef, citation), repeated so one file holds both.

heliad_view.description: The Heliad view or event the sources came from, when there was one.

id.description: Studio AbstractLayer id, or the Python layer name.

dataset.description: Heliad's dataset identity when the layer's files are in the library.

dataset_uid.description: Heliad's permanent dataset id (survives reindex); absent for files outside the library.

source_spec.description: How the layer asked for data: re-runnable when the sources themselves are missing.

sources.description: Every file the layer read, in time order. sha256 is the identity; Heliad resolves it through files.sha256.

source_count.description: Set when sources was shortened to fit an embedded container.

source_set_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the layer's source sha256 values, sorted, joined by newline. Lets a shortened record still be matched to a full one.

steps.description: Ordered operations from decoded file to the layer's contribution to the frame, user-set and automatic alike.

native.description: This layer's entry from the producer's scene, verbatim.

acknowledgement.description: The instrument team's required acknowledgement line for this dataset, when known.

source_url.description: Archive address, never a local path.

helioviewer.description: For JPIP or API layers: server, sourceId, image id. No file hash exists for these.

in_library.description: Whether the writer found this hash in its Heliad library.

op.description: Shared vocabulary. Unknown ops are shown verbatim by readers.

stage.description: Where it runs, so a reader knows which steps share a buffer.

automatic.description: True when the program applied it without a user setting (for example LASCO EXPTIME division).

params.description: Parameter names as the producer writes them (Studio: imageParams keys).

resolved.description: Values the step derived from the data at export time, e.g. the percentile clip bounds actually used.

stamp.description: An algorithm's own provenance line, e.g. RHEFStamp.line().

varies.description: Set when a parameter changed during a movie: names the parameters and points into native automation tracks. params then holds the value at the first frame.

automation.description: Automation track ids in the native scene.

reference.description: For difference steps: the frame subtracted. kind running = previous frame, base = a fixed source index.
